description: This file defines the EmailCampaign class and related functions for managing email campaigns, including validation, scheduling, sending emails, and updating statuses within the ERPNext system.

classes.name: EmailCampaign
classes.description: A class representing an email campaign, including validation, scheduling, and status updates.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the email campaign, including date validation and duplicate checks.

methods.name: set_date
methods.description: Sets the end date of the campaign based on the start date and campaign schedule.

methods.name: validate_lead
methods.description: Validates that the lead has an email address.

methods.name: validate_email_campaign_already_exists
methods.description: Checks if an email campaign with the same parameters already exists.

methods.name: update_status
methods.description: Updates the campaign status based on current date.
